kgi_status.target: Zero critical escapes, zero accepted false-completion claims, and complete fresh evidence.

kgi_status.target: Zero lost source work, durable checkpoints for every mutated lane, and measured recovery from provider/host/resource incidents.
kgi_status.observed: Three host restarts occurred in the recovery period. Exact Git reconstruction and checkpoints preserved source work; the measured 91.8 GiB Cargo duplication was removed and current active mutated lanes are checkpointed.

kgi_status.target: No batch stop caused solely by Codex quota; Claude/Fugu implementation and review remain recoverable from portable Git/log evidence.
kgi_status.observed: Implementation and review are running on Claude Opus 5 and Fugu 1.1 Ultra. A Claude 529 outage was resumed and hedged without Codex implementation, while Codex remains the coordinator.

kgi_status.target: After five comparable packets, reduce next-cohort median trusted-integration lead time and total cost by at least 20% with non-inferior quality.
kgi_status.observed: The first comparable five-packet cohort is not complete, so no efficiency target is claimed as achieved.

events.summary: The host restarted after operator-observed memory pressure and Windows C-drive exhaustion; /workspace had reached about 98 GiB and duplicated Cargo targets 91.8 GiB.
events.outcome: Git and worktree recovery plus reproducible-cache cleanup required.

events.summary: Twelve zero-length loose objects were quarantined, exact objects/commits were reconstructed, per-worktree Cargo targets were cleaned, and the disk-safe envelope was committed.
events.outcome: No missing/corrupt active Git object and no source loss; heavy Rust work remained paused.

events.summary: The initial implementation turn ended in 529 Overloaded after ten retries and 345.091 seconds of provider API time.
events.outcome: The exact session was resumed and a separate Fugu hedge was launched.

events.summary: The first MR-list product checkpoint made precedence, typed filesystem faults, authority fencing, and escrow memoization durable.
The first MR-mutation checkpoint moved decision work onto the caller request ledger.
The exact committed-tree focused module ran 33 tests in 62.057 seconds and reported one failure; the immediate diagnostic rerun did not reproduce it.
events.outcome: Candidate remained unready pending repeated-run classification.

events.summary: The clean no-diff outage hedge was deliberately stopped after the primary had a clean committed candidate.
events.outcome: The external slot was reclaimed for independent review rather than allowing duplicate investigation to age.

events.summary: Point sample: /workspace 3,074,977,792 bytes; aggregate Cargo targets 167,936 bytes; MemAvailable 16,816,082,944 bytes; swap used zero.
events.outcome: The current light Python/static-review wave remained inside the disk and memory envelope.

limitations: The third restart time and Fugu hedge stop time are operator-observed to minute precision; commit, session-file, and Claude event timestamps are exact to their recorded precision.
Active event logs may grow after capture; evidence hashes bind only the declared immutable byte prefixes.
The container cannot observe current Windows C-drive free space or prove VHDX compaction.
The Codex token value is a cumulative coordinator-thread sample and is not a billed-cost or per-package value.
Cross-provider token and cost totals are incomplete until each lane terminates and comparable provider usage records are available.
No five-packet comparable cohort or trusted current-wave integration existed at capture, so throughput, flow efficiency, useful parallelism, and the 20 percent KGI target remain unscored.
